name: theme
title: AMA Theme
description: Install first, once per app. AMA Precast tokens (logo navy #1A2250, website navy #0F0A35, concrete greys, signal yellow on navy only, cobalt actions), light and dark, density modes, type roles, status chip styles and the Tailwind v4 wiring that removes the default palette so only AMA tokens exist. Then add to app/globals.css, after @import "tailwindcss" and "tw-animate-css": @import "./ama/theme.css";
